svg.title: CMD & CTRL
svg.desc: Source of truth for the rounded app icon. The mark mirrors the login wordmark badge in src/routes/Login.svelte: a gold rounded square rotated 45 degrees with a small gold pip at its centre, on the theme ink (var bg, #0b0a09) in the theme gold (var gold, #d9b45c). Regenerate the PNGs with client/tools/gen-icons.sh after editing.
